architecture: index -> metadata -> Bronze -> Silver -> Gold -> Platinum; decision products consume qualified layers

bronze.reason: Exact export assets, terms and bytes not acquired.
bronze.contract: Immutable source-native payload, retrieval receipt, source/version identity, SHA-256 and separate rights evidence.

silver.reason: No qualified Bronze packet or verified upstream schema.
silver.contract: Canonical observations with source lineage, compatible age/geography/time definitions, units and explicit missingness.

gold.contract: Curated non-overlapping analysis cohorts, coverage/reconciliation reports and prespecified study-input panels.

platinum.contract: Rebuildable catalogue/semantic/serving projections; no fifth layer and no authoritative data stored only in a graph.

consumers.atlas-health-policy-anz: ANZ policy-source provenance only; no duplicated global mortality store
consumers.vop_poc_nz: Study-specific protocols, parameters, CEA/DCEA/BIA and perspective outputs
consumers.voiage: Qualified net-benefit draws and parameter bindings; no mortality archive in core library
consumers.microcosting_healthworkforce: Qualified workforce costing logic/inputs, not silently reused historical prices

forbidden_promotions: Missing or suppressed counts filled with zero
Age interpolation without a separately labelled model
Summing overlapping jurisdictions or age bands
Treating multiple extracts from the same register as independent observations
